backCover: This guide accompanies the two-day Microsoft 365 Copilot workshop. It follows one project, an AI Usage Guide for your department, from first research in Copilot Chat to a weekly check-in agent in Copilot Studio. Every chapter pairs short notes with copy-ready prompts you can use during the session and back at your desk.
